name: (6aR,9R)-N,N-diethyl-1-methoxy-7-methyl-6,6a,8,9-tetrahydro-4H-indolo[4,3-fg]quinoline-9-carboxamide
summary: 12-Methoxy-LSD, also known as 12-methoxylysergic acid diethylamide, is a drug of the ergoline and lysergamide families and a derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). In terms of chemical structure, 12-methoxy-LSD is to LSD as 5-MeO-DMT is to dimethyltryptamine (DMT), with 12-methoxy-LSD notably containing 5-MeO-DMT within its conformationally constrained structure.

pharmacology.text: It has been reported that 12-methoxy-LSD does not produce hallucinogenic effects in humans. However, it is nonetheless pharmacologically active in animal studies. The drug's effects in rabbits include antiserotonergic activity (20% of that of LSD) and hyperthermia (dose ratio relative to LD50 of 1:17 for 12-methoxy-LSD and 1:725 for LSD).

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: 12-Methoxy-LSD contains the whole shape of 5-MeO-DMT locked inside its rigid frame, yet it is reported not to cause hallucinations in people.
fact.zh: 12-Methoxy-LSD 在其堅硬的骨架中包含了完整的 5-MeO-DMT 結構，但據報導它不會讓人產生幻覺。
fact.zhHans: 12-Methoxy-LSD 在其坚硬的骨架中包含了完整的 5-MeO-DMT 结构，但据报导它不会让人产生幻觉。
